section.title: Overview
section.para: The BLADEC module can be used to create a message flow from Kamailio to any application that uses blade library.

section.title: &kamailio; Modules
section.para:
The following modules must be loaded before this module:
tm - (optional) needed only by bladec_async_relay()

section.title: External Libraries or Applications
section.para:
The following libraries or applications must be installed before running &kamailio; with this module loaded:
libblade

section.title: workers (int)
section.para: Number of worker processes to be started to handle incoming messages from remote applications.

section.title: bind_addr (str)
section.para: Local IP and port to listen on for incoming TCP connections.

section.title: event_callback (str)
section.para: The name of the function in the kemi configuration file (embedded scripting language such as Lua, Python, ...) to be executed instead of event_route[...] blocks.
The function receives a string parameter with the name of the event, the values are: 'bladec:connection-new', 'bladec:connection-closed', 'bladec:message-received'.

para.emphasis: Default value is 'empty' (no function is executed for events).

example.title: Set event_callback parameter

section.title: max_clients (int)
section.para: Maximum number of clients that can connect to bladec socket.

Relay the data given as parameter to connected applications. Before evaluating the parameter, the request processing is suspended using tm module (using the t_suspend()/t_continue() framework). The routing of the SIP request can be continued once event_route[bladec:message-received] is triggered. After bladec_async_relay() returns true, no relaying should happen in request_route(), it should be followed by exit;.
This function can be used from REQUEST_ROUTE.

If defined, the module calls event_route[bladec:connection-new] when a new client is connected.
If defined, the module calls event_route[bladec:connection-closed] when a client connection is closed.
If defined, the module calls event_route[bladec:message-received] when a message is received from a client.
